title: Accounts executive
description:
About the Role We are looking for a detail-oriented and responsible Accounts Executive to manage day-to-day accounting operations, taxation compliance, and financial record maintenance. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in GST, TDS, Tally, bookkeeping, and general accounting processes. 
 Key Responsibilities Maintain daily accounting entries and financial records Handle GST filing, reconciliation, and compliance Manage TDS calculation, deduction, and return filing Perform bank reconciliation and ledger scrutiny Prepare invoices, purchase entries, and expense records Work on accounting software such as Tally ERP / Tally Prime Maintain accounts payable and receivable records Assist in preparation of financial statements and MIS reports Coordinate with CA/auditors for audits and compliance Ensure proper documentation and record keeping 
 Required Skills Strong knowledge of GST and TDS regulations Hands-on experience in Tally ERP / Tally Prime Good understanding of accounting principles and bookkeeping Knowledge of MS Excel and basic reporting Attention to detail and accuracy in financial work Good communication and coordination skills 
 Qualification Bachelors degree in Commerce (B.Com) or related field Additional accounting or taxation certification will be preferred 
 Preferred Candidate Profile Ability to work independently and meet deadlines Prior experience in trading or distribution industry preferred Honest, organized, and process-oriented professional

Key Skills: TDS,Vendor,Filing,Gst Filing,Income tax return,Gst Return,Gst,Bank reconciliation
